const dxSub=u=>{if(u.kind!=='sports')return 9;const s=String(u.subject||'');return s.indexOf('学校体育')>=0?0:(s.indexOf('运动训练')>=0?1:(s.indexOf('运动生理')>=0?2:9))};const dxChap=u=>{const m=String(u.meta||'').match(/第([一二三四五六七八九十百]+)章/);if(!m)return 999;const t=m[1],d={'一':1,'二':2,'三':3,'四':4,'五':5,'六':6,'七':7,'八':8,'九':9};let n=0,c=0;for(const ch of t){if(ch==='十'){n+=(c||1)*10;c=0}else if(ch==='百'){n+=(c||1)*100;c=0}else if(d[ch])c=d[ch]}return (n+c)||999};arr.sort((a,b)=>{const sa=dxSub(a),sb=dxSub(b);if(sa!==sb)return sa-sb;if(sa<9){const ca=dxChap(a),cb=dxChap(b);if(ca!==cb)return ca-cb}return (weight(a.priority)+dxOrder(a))-(weight(b.priority)+dxOrder(b))||planMins(b)-planMins(a)||String(a.title).localeCompare(String(b.title),'zh')});
